objective: Expand Brain's simulation and optimization so goal planning considers, combines and compares far more possibilities, without arbitrary small caps. VERIFIED BASELINE (HEAD 88d7c9c, 2026-10-29): server/domain/scenario.ts SCENARIO_LIMITS = maxEvaluations 50_000, maxVariables 40, maxStrategies 8, maxRunMs 20_000; server/services/scenario/isolate.ts MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS = 1; server/services/goals/plan.ts ~L361 evaluations default 20_000; server/services/cash/goalScenario.ts MAX_MODEL_OPPORTUNITIES = floor((40-4)/8) = 4, excluded at ~L377 'the engine fits 4 openings in one model', strategies capped at maxStrategies ~L489. MEASURED (scripts/scenario-bench.ts, 2 vCPU, node 22): 50k evals median 346 ms, peak RSS 218 MiB, digest identical across runs; 20k evals median 176 ms. The engine runs ~50x under its own time budget, so limits are not set by measured cost. WORK, split by the architect into independent units with disjoint owned paths: (A) Staged planner over the FULL opportunity collection: cheap deterministic filters first (hard constraints, evidence present), candidate selection, plan/combination generation, simulate plans in batches of per-run-sized models, compare across batches on one consistent scoring basis, refine/expand where worthwhile. Per-run engine limits may remain but must never cap overall planning; no new small fixed cap. (B) Strategy generation driven by the goal: single-opportunity plans, weighted multi-opportunity mixes (no equal splits, no fixed count), effort/capital/time levels, action sequences, resource allocations; beam/greedy+local-search style pruning instead of exhaustive enumeration. (C) Time-aware constraints read from the goal's own record, never hardcoded: target amount, deadline, total capital, money allowed before first payment, weekly spend limits, workers/capabilities, hours, delivery and payment timing, dependencies, costs/losses. Capital is a ledger over time: proceeds from a completed transaction may fund later ones only when the timing genuinely allows. Cash collected after the deadline does not count toward a collected-cash goal. (D) Comparison by usefulness to the specific goal: evidence-supported expected outcome, downside, capital required, time to payment, workload, resources tied up, dependence on uncertain events, joint feasibility. Every input labelled VERIFIED / ESTIMATE / UNKNOWN; no invented probabilities; keep existing MONTE_CARLO justification and evidence gates. (E) Scalability: benchmark before and after with scripts/scenario-bench.ts extended to multi-batch planner workloads; raise or restructure SCENARIO_LIMITS, MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS and the goal-planning evaluation default only as far as measurements justify; batching/caching/pruning where it measurably helps; computation stays in the isolate worker off the main process; seeded reproducibility and clear errors preserved. (F) Connect results to goal execution through the existing goals plan/target services: output which plans deserve investigation, which missing facts would change the decision (value of information), which opportunities to drop, promising combinations, and what to test next; replan as evidence arrives; when no viable plan exists, report NO_VIABLE_PLAN and hand back to the existing discovery systems rather than presenting a simulation as success. Do NOT rebuild discovery/research. (G) Keep the planner general (resource allocation, scheduling, capacity, costs, risks) with cash goals as one adapter (goalScenario.ts), not the definition. Update docs/SCENARIOS.md. Prefer ordinary code for all math, filtering and benchmarks.
expectedOutcome: Goal planning reads every available opportunity, generates and simulates goal-specific single and combined plans in batches, enforces the goal's own time-aware capital/deadline/labour constraints, ranks plans by evidence-labelled usefulness, feeds next steps back to goal execution, and is measured faster-or-equal per evaluation with more plans examined.
nonGoals: Rebuilding discovery, research or evidence-collection systems
Hardcoding the current $10K goal, its deadline or its financial limits anywhere
Inventing success probabilities or relaxing evidence / MONTE_CARLO justification gates
Changing authorization, project isolation, credentials or account permissions
Exhaustively enumerating every mathematically possible combination
Running simulation on the main conversational process
Breaking CLAUDE.md invariant 39 (an unknown never makes a plan ready or ranks it higher) or 47 (a low-ranked possibility is kept in the space and reported, never discarded)

acceptanceConditions.statement: A goal with more than 4 eligible opportunities (test with at least 25) has all of them read and either planned or rejected with a stated reason; none is excluded for engine capacity.
acceptanceConditions.verification: New vitest under tests/ asserting every opportunity id appears in planned or rejected-with-reason output.

acceptanceConditions.statement: Planning compares more than 8 distinct useful strategies for one goal, across multiple engine batches, on one consistent score.
acceptanceConditions.verification: Test asserting >8 distinct strategies evaluated and that a strategy's score is identical whether evaluated alone or inside a batch.

acceptanceConditions.statement: A single opportunity able to meet the goal alone is found and ranked as viable.
acceptanceConditions.verification: Behavioral test with one sufficient opportunity among distractors.

acceptanceConditions.statement: Several opportunities that only collectively meet the goal produce a viable combined plan with unequal contributions.
acceptanceConditions.verification: Behavioral test; asserts the combined plan is viable and no single one is.

acceptanceConditions.statement: An opportunity with large projected revenue but upfront capital above the goal's capital or pre-payment limit is rejected for that constraint.
acceptanceConditions.verification: Test: $20,000 upfront / $50,000 projected vs a lower capital limit is rejected with the capital constraint named.

acceptanceConditions.statement: An opportunity paying after the goal deadline contributes nothing toward a collected-cash target due earlier.
acceptanceConditions.verification: Test: $15,000 paid after deadline does not satisfy a $10,000 earlier collected-cash goal.

acceptanceConditions.statement: Proceeds from an earlier completed transaction can fund a later one only when timing permits, and the capital ledger never goes below allowed limits at any time step.
acceptanceConditions.verification: Test with a sequenced plan that is feasible only via reinvestment, and a variant with payment arriving too late that is rejected.

acceptanceConditions.statement: Opportunities with missing or unsupported financial inputs are labelled UNKNOWN/ESTIMATE, are never ranked as verified-viable, and appear in the missing-information output.
acceptanceConditions.verification: Test asserting labels and that missing facts are listed as decision-changing.

acceptanceConditions.statement: Competing plans that share limited capital or workers are not jointly accepted when combined demand exceeds supply.
acceptanceConditions.verification: Test with two individually feasible plans that over-subscribe one worker or capital pool.

acceptanceConditions.statement: Repeated runs with the same seed and inputs produce identical rankings and result digests.
acceptanceConditions.verification: Test running the planner twice and comparing digests.

acceptanceConditions.statement: A heavy workload (at least 500 opportunities) completes within the configured budget off the main thread, without unbounded memory growth, and the server stays responsive.
acceptanceConditions.verification: Test or bench assertion on wall time, peak RSS and event-loop delay; numbers recorded in docs/SCENARIOS.md.

acceptanceConditions.statement: Before/after benchmark numbers are recorded and any changed limit cites the measurement that justifies it.
acceptanceConditions.verification: scripts/scenario-bench.ts output for old and new workloads committed in docs/SCENARIOS.md.

acceptanceConditions.statement: When no plan is viable, planning returns NO_VIABLE_PLAN with the eliminating constraints and missing facts, and goal execution continues discovery instead of reporting success.
acceptanceConditions.verification: Test through services/goals/plan.ts asserting status and the hand-back to discovery.
